items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: But we had been in we were, the Savoy just had opened and we thought we could (bump?) the Savoy because we had Louis and (Father Hines?).

ctx.x: Well he says, he got, with Dave Peyton at Café de Paris April 27 with Jimmy Noon at the (Nes?) before joining Clarence Jones at the Metropolitan Theater with Louis Armstrong. Left in late '27 playing briefly at the Warwick Hall with Louis Armstrong and Earl (Also Hines?).
Right. But we had been in we were, the Savoy just had opened and we thought we could (bump?) the Savoy because we had Louis and (Father Hines?). And man, nothing happened.
